top_concerns: Only baseline is CE on the full noisy set; no comparison with noisy-label methods (DivideMix, Co-teaching, ELR) or same-size random/small-loss subsets
Denoising mechanism is assumed rather than measured; experts/encoders are themselves trained on noisy labels
Corollaries (Eq. 10, 11) are stated without proofs, assumptions, or empirical checks
Possible test-set selection ('accuracies reported throughout distillation'); no seeds, variance, or validation split
Privacy, efficiency, tail-class and 'in the wild' claims are untested; only small ConvNets on CIFAR/Tiny-ImageNet/CIFAR-N
